grounds: Schema-level: psychMechanism and diagnosis are singular per node and both are memetic-specific ('Category error — confusing memetic success with philosophical validity'). Hosting the deontic form requires rewriting the node's identity fields — that is minting under an old id, not strengthening responses.

Presupposition inversion: the memetic form impugns the VIEW via propagation-failure; the universalizability form GRANTS truth arguendo and charges the MAXIM. Different target (view vs. maxim), different criterion (memetic fitness vs. law-likeness), disjoint apparatus (heliocentrism vs. Kant/Parfit).

Reader test as posed: the memetic trigger is 'It can't propagate itself' — that reader does not expect contradiction-in-conception analysis. The universalizability searcher deserves a node whose trigger voices their charge.
Grading integrity: the ledgered grade measures the memetic rebuttal against the memetic form; bolting a second dialectic into the long muddies the graded object.
Individuation precedent: red-button-repugnant (K194) — the charge-as-stated falls at its own node; the retreat exits to a named terminus elsewhere. Same architecture here.

node.diagnosis: This objection concedes truth to attack form: granting the antinatalist claim arguendo, it alleges the maxim fails as universal legislation because compliance empties its own constituency. Distinct from the memetic form (propagation-failure as evidence against truth), which is answered at self-defeating.
